name: Bro. Micheal Adeyemo
biography: President of the Life Way Baptist Student Fellowship (LWBSF). Dedicated to leading students into deep vertical alignment and kingdom leadership.

name: Rev'd Tunde Babatunde
biography: Rev'd Tunde Babatunde is a retired, Baptist trained Pastor. Before his ordination into full time ministry, he had ministered as evangelist and teacher of the word of life in many Baptist churches and some other denominations. His ministries extend to fellowships in higher institutions. He has served as President of BSF, Yaba College of Technology Lagos, President of The Christian Union Polytechnic Ibadan, and President of Lagos State Baptist Student Fellowship respectfully. His ministry focus is teaching the word with clarity, helping believers to grow strong in faith, encouraging a vibrant prayer life and equipping believers to walk in God's purpose.

name: Sis Mercy Ojo
biography: Student leader and intercessor passionate about campus revival, prayer coordinates, and fostering spiritual growth among the next generation.

name: Rev'd Adebisi Ikotun
biography: Anointed minister of the gospel and teacher, with a specific focus on awakening leaders to the current move of God and ministerial excellence.

name: Rev. Victor Adeleke Kolawole
biography: Rev. Victor Adeleke Kolawole is a Baptist-trained minister, called by God into an apostolic ministry, and graciously blessed with diverse spiritual gifts for the glory of God and the edification of the Body of Christ. He is known for his practical, life-applicable preaching of God's Word and the undeniable demonstration of the Holy Spirit's power.

name: Pst. Mrs. Adebusola Oguntola
biography: Pst. Mrs. Adebusola Oguntola is a passionate minister of the gospel with a heart for women, youth, and the next generation. She brings clarity, wisdom and the anointing of the Spirit to every platform she graces.

name: Bro. Sunday Oguntola
biography: Bro Sunday Oguntola is a child of God passionate about expanding the Kingdom of Light. A practising journalist, he is the author of 10 Commandments for Academic Excellence and Effective media relations for pastors and churches. He is the President of the Lagos State Baptist Student Alumni Fellowship (LSBSFAA) where he mentors the next generation of student leaders. He is married with kids.

name: Victoria Olayemi Olaogun
biography: Victoria Olayemi Olaogun is a Registered Nurse with over 27 years of clinical experience across hospital and industrial settings. A devoted Christian, she is a skilled public speaker on both spiritual and secular platforms. Victoria serves as a counsellor, mentor, and teacher. She is the convener of the Single Ladies Forum, an initiative dedicated to equipping young women to become responsible and effective mothers and wives. Her teaching spans health, spiritual growth, and marriage. She currently works as a Health and Wellness Specialist at a multinational company. Victoria is married to Oluwafemi, a pastor, and their marriage is blessed with both biological and spiritual children.
affiliation: Health & Wellness Specialist; Convener, Single Ladies Forum

name: EBUNOLAMISINGS
biography: EBUNOLAMISINGS is a Spirit-filled gospel artist and worship leader whose music carries the fragrance of heaven and points hearts directly to Jesus Christ. Through anointed vocals and spirit-led songwriting, EBUNOLAMISINGS creates an atmosphere where chains are broken, hearts are healed, and the presence of God is tangibly felt.

name: LSBSF Alumni President
biography: The President of the Lagos State Baptist Student Fellowship Alumni Association, representing decades of fellowship legacy and kingdom leadership development.

name: Rev'd Dr. Olafimihan Enoch Abimbola
biography: Rev'd Dr. Olafimihan Enoch Abimbola is a seasoned theologian and Baptist minister with decades of ministry experience. He brings deep scriptural insight and apostolic authority to every message, equipping the body of Christ for kingdom advancement.

name: Rev'd Ben Banjoko
biography: Seasoned Baptist minister and theologian committed to preaching the Word of God with clarity and power, focusing on spiritual growth and transformation.
